info.title: Ansa dashboard API
info.description: Self-service for a tenant organisation: its people, its agent's configuration, and its call history. Every request is scoped to one organisation by the session token that made it.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their organisation, and what they may do in it

401.description: No session, or a session that is no longer valid

post.summary: List the organisations an email and password can sign in to
post.description: Returns an empty list for a wrong password and for an address with no account, and takes the same time to do it.
